studyBanner.title: Study Path
studyBanner.description: Complete study guides for reviewing SAA-C03 and DEA-C01 theory before the practice exams, with decision tables, common traps and review checkpoints. Narration is disabled while English is selected.

home.arenaLead: Learn by answering. Every question is a turn: get it right and the enemy loses health; get it wrong and you do. Enemies come from each exam domain, so the difficulty follows what you still need to review.

about.title: About me
about.role: Product Specialist & Technical Instructor — transitioning to Cloud, Data & Dev
about.paragraph1: Product Specialist and Technical Instructor with more than 9 years of experience in printing solutions from Canon, Brother, Konica Minolta, Epson and Kyocera.
about.paragraph2: Throughout my career, I have developed strong analytical skills, structured technical diagnostics and the ability to communicate complex knowledge clearly to both technical teams and end users.
about.paragraph3: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development and have been expanding my work into technology and cloud, with a focus on:
about.paragraph4: My background in technical support, training and problem solving gives me a practical perspective that I apply directly to technology projects and studies, always with close attention to detail, organization and outcomes.
about.paragraph5: Open to connections and knowledge exchange in Cloud, Data and Software Development.
